call_points.text: Total network at 166 centres: 51 hubs and 115 spokes, including 26 processing units.
Surplus cash of about ₹330 Cr; cash PAT generation of 26-27%.
Last price hike was June 2025, restricted to Hyderabad; pricing strategy to be reassessed after Q2/Q3.
Competition in Hyderabad is muted as the second and third players deploy capital outside the city.
FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 40%, described as conservative, with management expecting to deliver more.
Q4 margin gain came from operating leverage and new hubs breaking even faster than guided.
Opex burn from new centres was about 0.8% of revenue in FY26 versus 2-2.5% envisioned.
Genomics is a long-term play with no significant revenue expected in the next few years.
Price hike of 1-1.5% planned for FY27, likely in Q1 or Q2, applied to select tests.
Hospital-based labs are a competitive threat, but management says Vijaya prices 20-25% below hospitals.
No plans to enter North India for 3-5 years; the Gurgaon centre will remain a single wellness centre.

timeline.summary: On its Q4FY26 earnings call (May 8, 2026), Vijaya Diagnostic guided FY27 capex at ₹140-150 Cr for 4-5 hubs and 10-12 spokes and an EBITDA margin of 40%, after FY26 revenue of ₹814 Cr and Q4 margin of 43.5%.

On its Q1FY27 earnings call on 7 August 2026, Vijaya Diagnostic guided FY27 revenue growth at high double digit and EBITDA margin above 40%, with capex of ₹190-195 Cr for 9 new hubs, 10-12 spokes and a Panjagutta reference lab.
